_doc: Hub alias rules. Formatting-only variants (case/spacing/punctuation, e.g. 'Farm Gate' vs 'Farmgate', 'Mirpur10' vs 'Mirpur 10') are merged automatically. Any OTHER spelling is merged only when listed here. Spelling proposals are written to data/generated/normalization_report.json -> hub_alias.proposed_aliases; review them and copy accepted ones into approved_aliases (or into rejected_aliases to silence them).
